answer: Farming becomes a saffron bet on surviving 87 epochs of grading, and every bridge settlement recomputes the jade schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 87 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 18 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
